title: If I go to Washington- will I be on my own? #25thAnnualPutnamCountySp...
transcript: Okay, who is coming with me to Washington, D. C. To see this production of Spelling Bee? Because this cast is absolutely insane. Like, you have Beanie Feldstein returning to the stage as Logan, and regardless of what you thought about her performance in Funny Girl, this is an absolutely perfect role for her. And we have Noah Galvin who is playing leaf. And I'm honestly kind of surprised they didn't get Ben Platt to play William after they got Beanie and Noah. But I'm definitely not complaining because instead we got Kevin McHale. If you have been watching my videos for any amount of time, you probably know that I am a massive Glee fan, so seeing Kevin on stage is unreal. And then of course Bonnie Milligan, who I adore, playing Rona. And she is actually going to be reuniting with Nina White, who was also in Kimberly Akimbo, who will be playing olive. And those two singing the I Love you song I think might break. This is honestly just the tip of the iceberg. We also got Alex Joseph Grayson, Taron Kelly Annazavelson, who I was a massive fan of in light in the Piazza. And so yeah. Suffice to say I immediately in post bought a ticket. I don't know how I'm getting down to DC yet, but I will be there because this is unmissable.
showTitle: The 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee
classificationReason: Creator is discussing casting announcements and expressing anticipation about seeing the show ('who is coming with me', 'I immediately bought a ticket') but has not yet seen this production.
